changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE locker24_device_health_latest ( device_id INT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, customer_id INT NOT NULL, received_at BIGINT NOT NULL, measured_at BIGINT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'green', status_reasons VARCHAR(256), non_green_since BIGINT, version_mismatch_since BIGINT, evaluated_at BIGINT, battery_pct SMALLINT, charging BOOLEAN, temperature_c REAL, free_storage_mb INT, rssi_dbm SMALLINT, kiosk_required BOOLEAN, kiosk_running BOOLEAN, kiosk_admin_unlocked BOOLEAN, kiosk_app_package VARCHAR(128), kiosk_app_version VARCHAR(64), agent_version VARCHAR(64), locker_short_uid VARCHAR(64), manufacturer VARCHAR(64), model VARCHAR(64), report_json TEXT NOT NULL );

changeSet.author: locker24
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE locker24_device_health_history ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, device_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, device_ts BIGINT NOT NULL, received_at BIGINT NOT NULL, measured_at BIGINT NOT NULL, battery_pct SMALLINT, charging BOOLEAN, temperature_c REAL, rssi_dbm SMALLINT, kiosk_running BOOLEAN, kiosk_admin_unlocked BOOLEAN, CONSTRAINT locker24_health_history_device_ts UNIQUE (device_id, device_ts) ); CREATE INDEX locker24_health_history_device_measured ON locker24_device_health_history (device_id, measured_at); CREATE INDEX locker24_health_history_measured ON locker24_device_health_history (measured_at);

changeSet.author: locker24
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE locker24_device_health_alerts ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, device_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, customer_id INT NOT NULL, condition VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, severity VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, raised_at BIGINT NOT NULL, last_present_at BIGINT NOT NULL, cleared_at BIGINT ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX locker24_health_alerts_open ON locker24_device_health_alerts (device_id, condition) WHERE cleared_at IS NULL;
